profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: As an accomplished Software Engineer, I have a track record of developing a diverse range of applications, including mobile video games, financial institution apps, soccer team apps, and distributed systems to build ads at scale for digital marketing companies. My passion for learning and eagerness to take on new challenges has led me to continuously expand my skill set and stay at the forefront of the industry.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building a unified governance platform for M365 Groups, Teams, SharePoint, and Power Platform, enabling seamless and secure user collaboration while maintaining strict governance processes across digital assets.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Tech Lead
positions.description:
• Led the development of a distributed digital marketing system that creates ads at scale for one of our clients in the real estate space generating over 10 million dollars in revenue and creating ads for more than 30.000 properties. I built this system using NodeJS Microservices on AWS Lambdas and ECS containers.

• Guided new Jr. developers and interns into our current projects, methodologies, and technologies.

• Conducted 1:1s with engineers of my team and helped them reach their personal and professional goals.

• Laid out the foundations of Aprimo Idea Lab, an ideation tool made for marketers. Using NodeJS Azure Functions, Cosmo DB, and ReactJS.

• Improved the availability of a core Java service, moving it from  EC2 machines to ECS containers. Later, I helped four other teams across the organization adopt this set-up.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
• Built the Soccer Fan App on Android and iOS for Universidad de Chile (Chile), Universitario (Peru),  Millonarios (Colombia). These apps supported over 30K users connected per game and had over 500K downloads.

• Developed the first versions of the PLS Mobile App. Native iOS and Android apps that help users to manage their Xpectations plan and Visa prepaid cards. These apps integrate with a C# back-end deployed in Azure.

• Promoted software architecture patterns and best practices for mobile applications across teams inside the company through a comprehensive article explaining the main cons and pros of architectures such as MVC, MVP, and MVVM.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant / Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Maintained and updated the school’s WPF kiosk application and Universal Windows application.
•	Created new Universal Windows solutions needed to help students to find relevant information about the university.
•	Developed new features for the school’s Android application based on Xamarin.
•	Developed and supported a new Universal Windows Phone application for the school.

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
•	Participated in the development of the IOS videogame Dancing Pig, which was built with Unity 3D, collaborating with the development of the in-app purchase system, Facebook integration, and the ads system integration.

•	Helped with the planning phase and developed a 3D top-down shooter mobile videogame demo using Unity3D.

•	Contributed to the development of a 2D mobile videogame demo using Unity3D. Creating the dynamics for the game characters and the levels specifications.

Projects:

•	Dancing Pig (2D Game - Unity 3D) - Published
•	Farm Defense (2D Game - Unity 3D)
•	Dimension Breach (3D Game - Unity 3D)
•	Quala Enterprise Applications (Protoype - PhoneGap)

positions.title: Web Engineer
positions.description:
•	Planned and developed software solutions for local and international brands to support advertising campaigns in order to bring digital experiences to the end users.

•	Coordinated and supervised software development projects outsourced with local and international companies.

•	Built a custom CRM web application based on Flex(AS3) to manage the demographics information for client’s advertising campaigns.
